text:
Jamie: quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today
Alex: thanks — brief recap pls?
Jamie: did a dry run of the AMS prewarm job against the new runtime image, validated init hooks but saw ~10% of nodes fail kubelet start during 'docker-setup' step
Alex: hmm ok. can you paste the failing kubelet snippet or error code?
Jamie: uploaded logs to the infra gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/infra-logs-ams-prewarm (contains timestamps + node ids)
Priya: I pulled the gist — looks like a network timeout contacting our internal registry, possibly transient but correlated with spot reclaim spikes
Liam: that aligns with last week's apac blips. i bumped spot buffer for apac by +20% yesterday, might need similar for AMS
Jamie: blocker: EU-WEST quota bump still pending (need +12 A100 equiv). finance/infra approval loop is holding it up
Priya: i opened a quota ticket with cloud provider yesterday; ticket #CLOUD-4982 and added the projected usage graph. waiting for provider approval ETA ~48h
Alex: today i'll finish the autoscaler rule tweak (scale-down hold and max-burst limits) and open a PR. can someone review? @Priya @Liam
Priya: will review after the capacity calc PR lands — should have time in ~2h
ops-bot: deploy-bot: prewarm-config v3 deployed to staging at 2025-11-02T09:12:45Z :white_check_mark:
Jamie: suggestion: temporary routing policy to fallback model variant in AMS when pending queue > 500 tokens/min so we don't impact latency-sensitive customers
Alex: agree. add a routing test and a canary flag. test locally with loadtest script:
```
./scripts/loadtest --region ams --qps 200 --duration 2m
```
Liam: FYI i already increased the regional buffer in apac, will monitor for 6 hours and revert if stable
Jamie: thank you — follow-ups: (1) Priya please paste quota ticket link in here when updated (2) Liam pls ping finance on the quota approval (3) Alex will open autoscaler PR for review
Priya: will paste ticket link once provider responds
Liam: pinged finance, included usage spreadsheet and urgency note
Alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2345 — request review @Priya @Jamie
Jamie: looked at PR, small nits only. main blocker remains quota; once that clears we can promote prewarm to prod
Priya: noted. if provider approves today we can schedule a controlled ramp Monday morning
Jamie: awesome. no further blockers from me after quota confirmation. :thumbsup:
Alex: thanks team — syncing async, will follow up in PR comments if anything else pops up
Liam: i'll keep an eye on node-start failure alerts and post any anomalies here
ops-bot: alert-bot: node-start-failure rate returned to baseline at 1977654600
Jamie: closing out — thanks everyone
__notes: This file is a single Slack thread in eng-infra. Messages are short, chronological, contain mentions, code block, links, and bot notes per agents.md rules.
